steps.name: Install gettext tools
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y gettext

steps.name: Validate translation files
steps.run:
echo "🔍 Validating translation files..."

# Check for required translation files
if [ ! -f "languages/rsl-wp.pot" ]; then
  echo "❌ Missing POT template file"
  exit 1
fi

# Validate POT file
msgfmt --check languages/rsl-wp.pot -o /dev/null || {
  echo "❌ POT file has syntax errors"
  exit 1
}

# Validate all PO files
for po_file in languages/*.po; do
  if [ -f "$po_file" ]; then
    echo "Checking $po_file..."
    msgfmt --check "$po_file" -o /dev/null || {
      echo "❌ $po_file has syntax errors"
      exit 1
    }

    # Check for required headers
    if ! grep -q "Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8" "$po_file"; then
      echo "❌ $po_file missing UTF-8 charset declaration"
      exit 1
    fi

    # Check for project version consistency
    PROJECT_VERSION=$(grep "Project-Id-Version:" "$po_file" | head -1)
    echo "Found version: $PROJECT_VERSION"
  fi
done

echo "✅ Translation file validation passed"

steps.name: Check MO file generation
steps.run:
echo "🔍 Testing MO file generation..."

for po_file in languages/*.po; do
  if [ -f "$po_file" ]; then
    mo_file="${po_file%.po}.mo"
    echo "Generating $mo_file from $po_file..."
    msgfmt "$po_file" -o "$mo_file" || {
      echo "❌ Failed to generate $mo_file"
      exit 1
    }

    # Verify MO file is not empty
    if [ ! -s "$mo_file" ]; then
      echo "❌ Generated $mo_file is empty"
      exit 1
    fi

    echo "✅ Successfully generated $mo_file"
  fi
done

steps.name: Install gettext tools
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y gettext

steps.name: Extract translatable strings
steps.run:
echo "🔍 Extracting translatable strings..."

# Generate current POT file
xgettext --language=PHP \
  --add-comments=translators \
  --keyword=__ \
  --keyword=_e \
  --keyword=_n:1,2 \
  --keyword=_x:1,2c \
  --keyword=_ex:1,2c \
  --keyword=_nx:4c,1,2 \
  --keyword=esc_attr__ \
  --keyword=esc_attr_e \
  --keyword=esc_html__ \
  --keyword=esc_html_e \
  --keyword=_n_noop:1,2 \
  --keyword=_nx_noop:3c,1,2 \
  --keyword=__ngettext_noop:1,2 \
  --from-code=UTF-8 \
  --output=languages/rsl-wp-current.pot \
  rsl-wp.php includes/*.php admin/templates/*.php || {
  echo "❌ Failed to extract strings"
  exit 1
}

echo "✅ String extraction completed"

steps.name: Analyze translation coverage
steps.run:
echo "🔍 Analyzing translation coverage..."

# Count total translatable strings
TOTAL_STRINGS=$(grep -c "^msgid" languages/rsl-wp-current.pot || echo "0")
echo "Total translatable strings: $TOTAL_STRINGS"

# Analyze each language
for po_file in languages/*.po; do
  if [ -f "$po_file" ]; then
    LANG=$(basename "$po_file" .po | sed 's/rsl-wp-//')
    echo "Analyzing $LANG translation..."

    # Count translated strings (non-empty msgstr)
    TRANSLATED=$(grep -A1 "^msgid" "$po_file" | grep "^msgstr" | grep -v '^msgstr ""$' | wc -l)
    FUZZY=$(grep -c "#, fuzzy" "$po_file" || echo "0")

    if [ "$TOTAL_STRINGS" -gt 0 ]; then
      COVERAGE=$((TRANSLATED * 100 / TOTAL_STRINGS))
      echo "  📊 $LANG: $TRANSLATED/$TOTAL_STRINGS strings ($COVERAGE% coverage)"
      echo "  🔄 Fuzzy translations: $FUZZY"

      # Set coverage thresholds
      if [ "$COVERAGE" -lt 80 ]; then
        echo "  ⚠️ Translation coverage below 80% for $LANG"
      elif [ "$COVERAGE" -ge 95 ]; then
        echo "  ✅ Excellent translation coverage for $LANG"
      fi
    fi
  fi
done

steps.name: Check for outdated translations
steps.run:
echo "🔍 Checking for outdated translations..."

for po_file in languages/*.po; do
  if [ -f "$po_file" ]; then
    LANG=$(basename "$po_file" .po | sed 's/rsl-wp-//')

    # Check if PO file needs updating
    if [ -f "languages/rsl-wp.pot" ]; then
      echo "Checking if $LANG needs updates..."
      msgmerge --quiet --output-file=/tmp/merged.po "$po_file" languages/rsl-wp.pot

      # Count new fuzzy entries (indicates outdated translations)
      NEW_FUZZY=$(grep -c "#, fuzzy" /tmp/merged.po || echo "0")
      OLD_FUZZY=$(grep -c "#, fuzzy" "$po_file" || echo "0")

      if [ "$NEW_FUZZY" -gt "$OLD_FUZZY" ]; then
        OUTDATED=$((NEW_FUZZY - OLD_FUZZY))
        echo "  ⚠️ $LANG has $OUTDATED potentially outdated translations"
      else
        echo "  ✅ $LANG translations are up to date"
      fi

      rm -f /tmp/merged.po
    fi
  fi
done

steps.name: Check WordPress i18n best practices
steps.run:
echo "🔍 Checking WordPress i18n compliance..."

# Check for proper text domain usage
EXPECTED_DOMAIN="rsl-wp"
echo "Expected text domain: $EXPECTED_DOMAIN"

# Find all translation function calls
TRANSLATION_ISSUES=0

# Check for missing text domain in translation calls
# Look for __( patterns that are clearly missing text domain (single line calls)
MISSING_DOMAIN_CALLS=$(grep -r "__(" --include="*.php" . | grep -v vendor/ | grep -v ".git/" | grep -v "rsl-wp" | grep -v "wordpress" | head -5)

if [ -n "$MISSING_DOMAIN_CALLS" ]; then
  echo "❌ Potential translation calls missing text domain:"
  echo "$MISSING_DOMAIN_CALLS"
  echo "Note: Multi-line calls may appear here - verify manually"
  # Don't fail for this since multi-line calls create false positives
fi

# Check for inconsistent text domain (informational only)
INCONSISTENT_CALLS=$(grep -r "__(" --include="*.php" . | grep -v "$EXPECTED_DOMAIN" | grep -v vendor/ | grep -v ".git/" | grep -v "wordpress" | head -3)

if [ -n "$INCONSISTENT_CALLS" ]; then
  echo "⚠️ Potential inconsistent text domain usage (check manually):"
  echo "$INCONSISTENT_CALLS"
fi

# Note: load_plugin_textdomain is not required since WordPress 4.6
# WordPress automatically loads translations when Text Domain header is present

# Check plugin header for text domain
if ! grep -q "Text Domain: $EXPECTED_DOMAIN" rsl-wp.php; then
  echo "❌ Plugin header missing or incorrect text domain"
  TRANSLATION_ISSUES=$((TRANSLATION_ISSUES + 1))
fi

# Check for WordPress.org readme text domain
if [ -f "readme.txt" ]; then
  if ! grep -q "Text Domain: $EXPECTED_DOMAIN" readme.txt; then
    echo "⚠️ readme.txt missing text domain declaration"
  fi
fi

if [ "$TRANSLATION_ISSUES" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "✅ WordPress i18n compliance checks passed"
else
  echo "❌ Found $TRANSLATION_ISSUES i18n compliance issues"
  exit 1
fi
